jobs.title: Demand Marketing Lead, UK
jobs.description:
**Building the marketing department for the future**
Marketing at Euromonitor is being reimagined. We're building an AI-powered growth engine: agentic, automated, and data and tech led. A B2B marketing system designed for 2030, not 2015.
  
  
Behind it sits an advantage most companies would envy: original research from analysts across 210 markets, and decades of proprietary data built over more than 50 years. Our job is to turn that into growth.
  
  
And not incremental growth. We're not here for 10% better. We're building for 10x, and then 100x. That ambition sets the standard for everything we do, and everyone we hire.
  
  
So this is for people who want to drive transformation, not wait for it. Restless. Ambitious. More interested in building the engine than operating one someone else designed. If that sounds like you, this is a rare moment to join Euromonitor, and something special to be part of.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The
**Demand Marketing Lead, UK,**
is a key driver of revenue growth in the UK market, accountable for the leads and opportunities generated, the pipeline created, and the revenue closed. This is a hands-on, target-holding role: running an always-on demand generation programme tailored to the UK, tailoring global campaigns and initiatives for regional impact, and developing the local initiatives this market specifically needs.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Act as a key driver of revenue growth in the UK market, accountable for the leads and opportunities generated, the pipeline created, and the revenue closed.
* Run an always-on UK demand generation programme, covering campaigns, lead nurture and regional initiatives.
* Take global campaigns and initiatives and tailor them for the UK market to drive engagement and ROI.
* Identify opportunities specific to the UK market and develop initiatives to go after them, such as local events, partnerships and competitive responses.
* Partner closely with local sales teams on hand-off criteria, pipeline reviews, forecasting and lead scoring and qualification.
* Work with centralized marketing automation, CRM and paid media teams to brief and guide regional execution, rather than running these platforms directly.

**What Success Looks Like**

* UK pipeline and closed-won revenue targets consistently met or exceeded, in partnership with the local sales team.
* Global campaigns land with strong engagement and ROI once tailored for the UK market.
* UK-specific initiatives make a measurable contribution to pipeline, beyond centrally run programmes alone.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years' experience in demand generation or performance marketing, ideally including experience holding a personal revenue or pipeline target.
* All experience must be in B2B marketing. A B2C-only background won't fit this role.
* Has personally held and delivered against a revenue target before, not just a lead or activity target.
* Comfortable partnering closely with local sales teams on hand-off, forecasting and pipeline reviews.
* Track record of tailoring national or global campaigns for a specific market, with a clear focus on ROI.
* Confident briefing and directing centralized marketing automation, CRM and paid media specialists, even without running those platforms hands-on day to day.
* Some experience working with AI, whether in a professional role or through personal projects, is something we look for in every hire joining Euromonitor Marketing right now.

**Benefits**
**Why work for Euromonitor?**
**Our Values:**

* We seek individuals who act with integrity
* We look for candidates who are curious about the world
* We feel that as a community, we're stronger together
* We seek to enable people to feel empowered
* We welcome candidates who bring strength in diversity

**International:**
not only do we have a very multinational workforce in each office but we communicate across our 16 offices worldwide on a daily basis.
  
  
**Hardworking and sociable:**
our staff know how to work hard and know also how to enjoy themselves! We pride ourselves on creating an appropriate work-life balance, with flexible hours and regular socialising including frequent after work meet ups, summer and Christmas parties and a whole range of other groups to be involved with.
  
  
**Committed to making a difference:**
We believe that people are looking for something worthwhile in a company beyond the workplace. Our extensive Corporate Social Responsibility Programme gives each member of staff two volunteering days a year in addition to holidays. It gives all new starters a donation amount on joining us which they can give to a charity of their choice.
  
  
It sees us reaching out into the local community with our mentoring, group volunteering, and fundraising initiatives as well as supporting international charities through our website sales, matching staff sponsorship fundraising, and carbon offsetting all our flights.
  
  
**Excellent benefits:**
we offer competitive salaries, enhanced healthcare and pensions, plus generous holiday allowances, hybrid working and, in many offices, a Core Hours policy allowing flexible start and finish times to each day.
  
  
**Opportunities to grow:**
we offer extensive training and development opportunities at all levels. The vast majority of our Managers and Directors have been promoted from within and many have moved across departments as well as upwards. We pride ourselves on identifying and rewarding talent.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:**
Euromonitor International does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability and genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, or other non-merit factor.

jobs.title: Regional Channel Marketing Manager - UK and Spain
jobs.description:
**Are you a commercially minded marketing professional who understands what it takes to sell products, grow markets and build successful distribution partnerships?**

Fieldpiece is a privately held, global leader in professional HVACR tools and test instruments. We're known for developing innovative products that technicians rely on every day - and for investing in our people, our technology and our future. Named one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years, we bring that same commitment to culture and excellence to our teams around the world. As we continue to scale, we're looking for talented people who want to help shape our future while growing their own career.

We’re hiring a **Regional Channel Marketing Manager** to drive growth in our markets in the United Kingdom and Spain. Reporting to the EMEA Marketing Director, this is a new role that offers the opportunity to build and shape regional channel and trade marketing, with the autonomy to develop and execute strategies that directly impact business growth in the region. You’ll be the expert in your region and closely connect marketing, sales and our distribution partners. To support sales growth, you’ll use your commercial and business acumen to engage in mapping the market, identify commercial opportunities, manage marketing budgets and resources. With external agency support for creative development and campaign execution, your focus will be on market strategy, sales enablement and maximizing marketing investments.

You must live in London - ideally near London or Northampton OR Spain - ideally near Barcelona. The expectation for travel is about 25%.

**What You'll Do**

* **Develop regional growth strategies:** Map markets, analyze competitors, segment customers and identify opportunities to increase market share and revenue.
* **Enable sales growth:** Proactively partner with regional sales teams to identify commercial opportunities, support sales forecasting and develop targeted growth initiatives.
* **Strengthen distribution partnerships:** Understand distributors' businesses, customers and sales challenges to develop effective, tailored channel and trade marketing programs.
* **Own regional marketing planning and budgets:** Develop an annual marketing calendar and allocate investments based on seasonality, sales cycles, product launches, promotions and regional opportunities.
* **Drive localized marketing execution:** Manage external agencies and marketing partners to deliver relevant campaigns, events, communications and distributor programs while maintaining brand consistency.
* **Measure and improve performance:** Evaluate marketing ROI, track business impact and continuously improve strategies, processes and investment decisions.

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 7+ years of marketing experience, including channel marketing, trade marketing, commercial marketing, partner marketing or regional marketing.
* B2B experience within a product-based business, with a strong understanding of distributor or indirect sales channels.
* Firsthand field sales experience and an understanding of the challenges sales teams and distribution partners face in growing revenue.
* Experience analyzing markets, assessing competitive landscapes, segmenting customers and identifying commercial growth opportunities.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, annual marketing calendars and investment priorities.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect marketing activities to sales performance and business growth.
* Excellent communication, presentation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to articulate recommendations, influence stakeholders and confidently engage with business leaders and distribution partners.
* Professional fluency in English and Spanish - native-level proficiency in the local language(s) preferred.

**HVACR or technical product experience is not required.** We welcome candidates from a variety of product-based industries, including FMCG, beverages, consumer goods, tools and industrial products.

**What Will Make You Successful**

You're commercially savvy, naturally curious and interested in how businesses operate, markets differ and customers make purchasing decisions. You bring professional maturity, sound business judgment and the confidence to present well-supported recommendations. You're proactive, comfortable working independently and motivated by the opportunity to build something new and take ownership of results.

**Why Join Fieldpiece?**

* **Build something new.** This is a newly created position and a new approach to regional marketing. You'll have the opportunity to shape the role and establish how regional channel and trade marketing operate.
* **Make a measurable impact.** Your work will directly support regional revenue growth, market expansion and distributor success.
* **Have ownership and autonomy.** Develop strategies and manage investments based on your knowledge of the market, rather than following a one-size-fits-all marketing plan.
* **Focus on the business.** With external agency support for creative development and campaign execution, you can focus on market strategy, commercial opportunities and sales enablement.
* **Grow with us.** Join a growing global business where your contributions are visible and your responsibilities can evolve as the company expands.

Product Manager - Fragrances, Luxe Division
  
  
We're looking for a commercially minded Product Manager to join our Luxe division, leading the marketing strategy across the UK&I for our fragrance cluster. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you'll build and execute plans that drive brand equity, consumer recruitment and market share for the fragrance portfolio. You'll shape brand positioning, pricing and investment decisions, working closely with commercial, digital and category teams to turn insight into action. You'll also steer the relationship with international marketing and Zone teams, championing UK&I priorities. This is an opportunity to lead market-leading luxury fragrance launches from strategy through to in-store execution.
  
  
A DAY IN THE LIFE
  

* You define the brand strategy, pricing positioning, and investment choices alongside Finance to drive sustainable category growth.
* You partner closely with commercial, digital, and category experts to evaluate sell-out performance and extract actionable consumer insights.
* You translate strategic vision into actionable briefs for media, visual merchandising, advocacy, and external creative agencies.
* You deliver accurate launch volume forecasts with Demand Planning, maximising commercial opportunities while actively minimising slow-moving inventory.
* You produce monthly retail packs and phasing strategies in close collaboration with National Account Managers and field teams.
* You steer the relationship with international marketing (DMI) and Zone teams, championing local UK&I market priorities and brand positioning.

WHO YOU ARE
  
  
You bring a strategic commercial mindset and a talent for brand storytelling to champion market-leading luxury launches. You bring:
  

* Strategic Marketing: You craft customer-centric marketing plans and articulate clear brand positioning across luxury touchpoints.
* Commercial Acumen: You interpret sell-out trends and analytics to steer investments and achieve launch excellence.
* Demand Forecasting: You collaborate cross-functionally to plan launch volumes, sample allocations, and promotional coffrets.
* Stakeholder Management: You align cross-functional teams, Zone partners, and creative agencies behind unified go-to-market roadmaps.
* Project Management: You steer multifaceted campaign timelines from brief to in-store execution with high precision.

WHAT WE OFFER
  
  
Our industry-leading award-winning benefits package shows how much we value our people. We know they're at the heart of L'Oréal's success, so we offer a fair and competitive package to help you thrive.
  
  
Enjoy perks like money-saving offers, free mortgage advice, share options and an enhanced pension plan. Love our brands? You'll get up to 60% off iconic names like YSL, CeraVe, Armani, Kiehl's and Garnier! Because health matters, we offer private medical and dental insurance, discounted gym memberships, and onsite mental health support. We also provide enhanced family leave for all and up to 4 weeks of paid fertility leave, so you can prioritise what matters most.
  
  
Learning is in our DNA at L'Oréal. We'll help you master your role, build skills, and access top-notch leadership programs and monthly expert talks. And there's lots more too!
  
  
WHO WE ARE
  
  
L’Oréal is present in 150 markets on five continents. Together, we solve complex challenges at scale, while making sure we stay committed to making the world a more inclusive and a better place for everyone & our planet. Thanks to our strong, balanced and complementary portfolio as well as our incredibly talented team of experts we are perfectly equipped to meet the endless and all-encompassing demands of luxury consumers around the world.

When we recruit, hire, train, promote or engage in any other employment practice, we are committed to being an inclusive employer regardless of race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, socioeconomic status, medical condition or disability, or any other protected status. jobs.description:
**We are Wiser,** a global, award-winning Employer Brand agency.

We build employer brands to guide the best in the biz into their dream career with our clients.  
We’re a home for people who think big and expect more. We transform a company’s employer brand internally and externally and change cultures from the ground up.
  
  
With creative, strategic and early talent experts in-house, our clients have a single partnership with Wiser and we deliver end to end campaigns helping them to attract and retain the best talent globally.  
  
We believe that people will do their best work when they're in a space that enables it. And that's what we've shaped at Wiser - a culture where everyone can be real and back themselves, surrounded by high performers who take ownership of their career and make moves, no matter what their background.  
  
To find out more about us, take a look at our website wearewiser.com  
or check us out on Instagram @wearewiser.

**What's this role all about?**  
  
Our award-winning Campaigns team at Wiser is scaling fast, launching recruitment marketing campaigns across the globe for some of the world’s biggest brands.

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you'll own the why behind recruitment marketing and employer branding campaigns for some of our biggest global clients. You'll lead campaigns from brief to sign-off: setting the strategy and objectives, shaping the creative, holding teams to account and turning the results into a story clients act on.

You'll work alongside our Media specialists, who plan, build and optimise the media, as well as our Creative, Research, Strategy and Accounts teams.

##### **What will you spend your time doing?**

* Owning campaigns for global clients from brief to sign-off, and being the client's go-to person for your campaigns
* Setting campaign strategy and objectives, grounded in audience insight and the roles the client needs to fill
* Briefing and steering our Creative teams, and pushing the work until it's right for the audience and the platform
* Working closely with the Media team, from shaping the brief to sense-checking plans and builds before anything goes live, so the media delivers what the campaign needs
* Signing off performance reports and presenting them to clients, turning data into clear insights and next steps
* Scoping the work and keeping it on plan and on budget, with timings, approvals and hours tracked
* Growing your accounts by spotting the next phase, market or test, and scoping it into something the client wants to buy
* Supporting pitches and new business with campaign thinking where needed

##### **What are we looking for?**

* 5+ years' experience in campaign management, ideally within a medium to large agency, with paid media at the heart of it
* Hands-on experience across LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok, Google and YouTube to challenge a media plan, spot a build error and question a report
* A strategic mind: you can find the insight in audience research and turn it into a brief creatives want to pick up
* Confidence with data and performance metrics, and the ability to turn numbers into clear stories and recommendations
* Comfortable with Google Analytics, tracking pixels and UTMs, and you can tell when the tracking doesn't add up
* Excellent organisation: you can run multiple campaigns across different clients and keep each one on plan
* Strong attention to detail, checking your own work and other people's
* Confidence with senior clients, including when the news isn't good
* Curiosity about new formats, platforms and AI tools, and how they can make campaigns work harder
* Bonus: experience in employer branding, recruitment marketing or corporate is a strong advantage and should be highlighted in your application

##### **What's in it for you?**

* A Happiness team whose role is to make Wiser the best place to work possible. Whether it’s keeping the office stocked up with snacks, sending you a care package when you’re poorly, or planning the next Wiser party, they make the office a much happier place
* A culture calendar full of options - from black tie to sports day, book club or run club, there’s something for everyone.
* We’re pretty proud of the space we have here - from phone booths to walking pads, all the way to a rainforest for focus-time… whatever vibe you need, you can find it here.
* The W breakfast - our Happiness team makes sure everyone starts the day right with a hotel-worthy breakfast spread. Fancy coffee tap and unlimited fizzies on offer too.
* On top of your holiday allowance, the office also closes for up to 2 weeks over the festive period so we can all recharge before coming back in the new year.
* Birthday Bank Holiday - Take your birthday off, on us!
* Moving House Day - one of life’s most stressful events made easier by an extra day off.
* Work from Anywhere - everyone has a number of days to work from home or wherever they fancy. Whether it’s staying home to snuggle your cat or working from Greece for a week in the summer, WFA is the answer.
* Learning & development - our monthly ‘Wiser Way’ days give you the chance to choose from a selection of training modules taught by our leaders. Whether it’s how to craft the perfect deck with our Creative Director, how to speak confidently about commercials with our CFO, or get some tips on managing for the first time with our Head of People, the schedule has something for everyone
* Therapy - with 5 therapists to choose from, each year you can get up to x3 therapy sessions subsidised through Wiser to take either here in our own secret Log Cabin, externally or online (you pay £20 a session and we cover the rest)
* Vitality Health Insurance - full coverage once you’ve passed probation. From necessities like the dentist, doctors and opticians, to mega rewards like Champneys, gym and travel discounts, it’s a winner.
* Gymbox - once passing probation, you can access our exclusive Wiser x Gymbox partnership where you can bag your Gymbox membership for less

jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

At CloserStill, we strive to deliver the best. We’re on a mission to be the most dynamic B2B events and communities business in every market we serve, bringing people together to learn, connect and grow.  
  
Operating across five regions, we power over 200 market-leading events, publications and brands across Technology, Healthcare, Learning and HR, and Future Transport & Infrastructure.  
  
But what truly sets us apart is our people.

Our teams are diverse, driven, and united by a shared commitment to excellence. Rooted in our core values of ownership, empathy, teamwork, integrity, and determination, we empower every employee to grow, shape their own path and make a meaningful impact.  
  
Joining CloserStill means being part of something bigger - not just building events, but creating opportunities, connections, and lasting value for the communities we serve.  
  
**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

We are looking for an experienced B2B digital marketer with at least five years of relevant experience, ideally five to six years or more. An agency background or experience in events, exhibitions or conferences would be particularly valuable.

The right candidate will be comfortable working directly in advertising platforms, managing several campaigns and explaining performance clearly. They will take ownership, raise issues early and recommend practical solutions.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Senior Digital Marketing Executive will plan, deliver and optimise digital campaigns across an assigned portfolio of exhibitions and conferences. The role will support visitor and delegate registrations, exhibitor enquiries and qualified leads, with a clear focus on campaign performance and commercial results.

This is a hands-on role with responsibility for agreed campaigns and day-to-day delivery. The successful candidate will work independently, use data to make recommendations and support colleagues through practical guidance and knowledge sharing.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

Turn event objectives into practical digital campaign plans. Deliver relevant audiences and qualified enquiries while managing budgets, meeting deadlines and improving conversion.

Work with the Group Digital Manager, Digital Marketing Manager and colleagues across Show Marketing, Sales, CRM, Data and Technology to improve campaign delivery and measurement. Apply approved AI tools and automation where they offer a clear benefit.

**CAMPAIGN PLANNING**

* Develop campaign plans around each event’s audience, commercial objectives and deadlines. Take responsibility for agreed activities and delivery.
* Translate briefs into channel plans, audience targeting, budget recommendations and clear measures of success. Seek manager input where decisions fall outside the agreed scope.
* Plan visitor and delegate acquisition alongside exhibitor and sponsor lead generation, using appropriate messages and measures for each audience.
* Manage competing priorities, deadlines and dependencies across campaigns. Raise risks early, explain their impact and recommend a way forward.
* Challenge briefs constructively when the budget, content, tracking or website journey is unlikely to deliver the intended result.

**PAID MEDIA DELIVERY**

* Plan, build, manage and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Microsoft Advertising.
* Manage campaign structure, audiences, keywords, exclusions, retargeting, bidding and testing. Keep spend within agreed budgets and authority.
* Review performance regularly and recommend changes to targeting, budget allocation, creative or landing pages.
* Prepare clear briefs for campaign creative, messaging and landing pages.
* Complete launch checks and maintain consistent naming conventions, tracking links, account settings and documentation.
* Coordinate programmatic campaigns with specialist partners where required. Direct experience of a demand-side platform is desirable.

**MEASUREMENT AND REPORTING**

* Review the journey from an advert to a registration or enquiry and identify opportunities to improve conversion.
* Recommend improvements to landing pages, calls to action and forms, working with the relevant content and technical colleagues.
* Use advertising platform data, GA4, conversion tracking, reporting tools and available CRM data to explain performance and recommend action.
* Provide concise weekly updates, forecasts and campaign reviews covering results, spend, risks and next steps.
* Explain the difference between platform conversions and verified registrations, attendance, qualified leads or revenue.
* Use SEO principles, Google Search Console and Semrush to identify issues affecting visibility or conversion. Refer technical changes to the relevant colleagues.

**STAKEHOLDER AND SUPPLIER COORDINATION**

* Be the day-to-day Digital contact for assigned campaigns. Keep stakeholders informed of progress, decisions and risks.
* Lead or contribute to campaign planning and performance discussions, explaining recommendations clearly and challenging assumptions constructively.
* Agree responsibilities, deadlines and dependencies with Show Marketing and other delivery teams.
* Maintain clear campaign plans and action records. Escalate unresolved issues with context, impact and proposed solutions.
* Coordinate agencies, programmatic partners and other suppliers against agreed briefs, deadlines and deliverables.

**SUPPORTING COLLEAGUES**

* Support junior colleagues through practical guidance, knowledge sharing and appropriate delegation. The role has no formal line management responsibilities.
* Review campaign builds and reports when required, helping colleagues maintain consistent standards.
* Share useful knowledge across paid media, analytics, campaign delivery and AI tools.
* Improve templates, documentation and working practices to make delivery more consistent and efficient.

Unity’s Grow business empowers developers and publishers to build profitable and scalable applications through AI/ML-powered user acquisition, monetization, and engagement tools. With products including Unity Ads that leverages Unity Vector, the AI foundation for user acquisition, alongside LevelPlay mediation and Tapjoy Offerwall, the Grow platform reaches billions of users across the mobile app ecosystem and plays a critical role in Unity’s real-time 3D (RT3D) creator economy.

* Customer and Persona Segmentation - Define clear, actionable customer personas (e.g., major mobile publishers with multiple titles, indie devs, monetization managers, UA specialists) with distinct needs and use cases.
